name: Nettipoika Studio
tagline: Build, preview and publish websites on managed EU hosting
description: Create, edit, preview and publish websites and small web apps from Cline: static sites, Go and Django with PostgreSQL, HTTPS, drafts with a private preview, version history and rollback on managed hosting in Europe. OAuth sign-in with scoped, revocable access. Needs a Nettipoika Studio subscription; the first 60 days are free.

install.notes: Sign in to Nettipoika Studio in the browser when Cline asks. You approve the access and its permissions there and can revoke them at any time.
